if not __luauIter then
    __luauIter = function(iterable, ...)
        if type(iterable) == "table" then
            return iterable
        end
        if type(iterable) == "function" then
            return iterable, ...
        end
        return function() return nil end
    end
end

if not __aerisSafeResult then
    __aerisSafeResult = function(...)
        local first = select(1, ...)
        if first == nil then
            return nil
        end
        return first
    end
end

if not __aerisSafe then
    __aerisSafe = function(fn, ...)
        if type(fn) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        local ok, res = pcall(fn, ...)
        if ok then
            return res
        end
        return nil
    end
end

-- Every stub returns a table whose members are callable no-ops and whose
-- properties can be read/written freely, so a missing global never throws.
if not __aerisStubMeta then
    __aerisStubMeta = {
        __index = function(self, key)
            local cached = rawget(self, "__cache")
            if type(cached) == "table" and cached[key] ~= nil then
                return cached[key]
            end
            local proxy
            proxy = setmetatable({}, {
                __call = function() return nil end,
                __index = function() return proxy end,
                __newindex = function() end,
                __tostring = function() return "" end,
                __len = function() return 0 end,
                __eq = function() return false end,
                __concat = function(a, b)
                    if type(a) == "string" then return a end
                    if type(b) == "string" then return b end
                    return ""
                end
            })
            if type(cached) == "table" then
                cached[key] = proxy
            end
            return proxy
        end
    }
end

if not getAerisStub then
    getAerisStub = function(name)
        local store = rawget(_G, "__AERIS_STUBS")
        if type(store) ~= "table" then
            store = {}
            _G.__AERIS_STUBS = store
        end
        local existing = store[name]
        if existing then
            return existing
        end
        local stub = setmetatable({
            Name = name, Value = false, Text = name, Visible = false, Disabled = false,
            __cache = {}
        }, __aerisStubMeta)
        store[name] = stub
        return stub
    end
end

    __aerisMethod = function(name, method, ...)
        local stub = getAerisStub(name)

        return fn
    end
end

local RunService = game:GetService(fQ(0x3f1-0x3ee))
local Stats = game:GetService(fQ(0x309-0x17d))
local fb = (0x5aa-0x5aa)
local LastFPSUpdate = os.clock()
local uR = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
fb =  fb + ( (0x139-0x138))
local OU = os.clock()
local yt = OU - LastFPSUpdate
if yt >= 0.5 then
local Ce = math.floor((fb / yt) + 0.5)
fb = (0x2a5d-0x2a5d)
LastFPSUpdate = OU
if zb and zb.Parent then
zb:SetText(fQ(0x256-0xac) .. Ce)
end
end
end)
while oZ and oZ.Parent and not Library.Unloaded do
local bj = math.floor(os.clock() - m0)
local Bt = math.floor(bj / (0x12c7-0x563+0xac))
local us = math.floor((bj % (0x1ee+2*0x611)) / (0x288f-0x2853))
local xx = bj % (0x92c-0x8f0)
oZ:SetText(string.format(
fQ(0x2bc-0x111),
Bt, us, xx
))
local Ping
local _ok = pcall(function()
Ping = Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem[fQ(0x263-0xd5)]:GetValue()
end)
if Ping and TE and TE.Parent then
TE:SetText(fQ(0x469-0x2bd) .. math.floor(Ping + 0.5) .. fQ(0x555-0x3a8))
end
task.wait(0.5)
end
local _ok = pcall(function()
uR:Disconnect()
end)
end)
